body:
PR #1068 head `0da9ba9c3ff8bb67e9f13c53b9f111e098e3d5b7` fails the required Python quality gate in the new `src/mediaingredientmech/validation/mapping_change_receipts.py`.

The actual [CI job](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/actions/runs/41334950024/job/124932684927) passed Ruff and Black, then `just typecheck` reported 17 mypy errors: unannotated counters/maps, JSON values returned as Any, incompatible temporary row-state inference, and insufficient narrowing of optional heterogeneous hold checkpoint fields.

The local runtime tests and native QC passed, but do not establish static type correctness. Repair the types without weakening runtime receipt validation or mypy configuration; run the exact native `just lint format-check typecheck` recipe, focused receipt tests and affected native review/export chain. Refresh code-bound review inputs, retain the original failed CI evidence, and obtain independent review of the final head before queue admission.

Scope: strict #764/#766 replacement PR #1068. No scientific approval, canonical mapping or ingredient changes are authorized by this repair.
